brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights documented 15 Israeli military attacks across the Gaza Strip between August 24 and 29, 2026, killing 22 Palestinians and injuring dozens more. The strikes struck multiple areas throughout the territory, destroying residential homes alongside mosques, prayer halls, and civilian infrastructure.

The attacks damaged water plants, economic facilities, and service infrastructure across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights. Damage to religious structures and essential utilities compounded the toll on civilian populations. The documented strikes represent part of what the rights group characterized as ongoing operations affecting civilians and civilian objects in the territory.

title: Israeli strikes kill 22 Palestinians, destroy homes across Gaza in five days
